item.title: Wisp 1.4.2
item.description:
• Smarter fallback when Gemini is busy. Wisp now skips special-purpose Gemini models that can’t answer questions (they used to stop the fallback with an error), and it reaches more backup models, including the Lite ones with bigger free quotas.
  • If your free Gemini quota is used up for the day, Wisp now says so and tells you when it resets.
